_source: Polley and Panjeh Shahi (1991), Trans IChemE 69 A, 445-457, Table 4 (Network 6.1) and Table 5 (Network 5.1): results of the detailed (Bell-Delaware) exchanger designs for the four-stream problem; physical properties in Table 3 (all streams rho 800 kg/m3, cp 2600 J/kgK, mu 0.5 cP, k 0.12 W/mK, Rf 0.00018 m2K/W). Transcribed from the scanned paper (project file G5.5); exchanger labels E1-E4, C and H1-H2 mapped to matches by their expected size, which equals the 'published_expected_area_m2' of sagli1990_networks.json.
_columns: shells: number of shells ('1(J)' recorded as 1, J shell); tubes per shell; passes: tube passes; d_o_mm / d_i_mm / pitch_mm; length_mm: tube length; h_io and h_o in W/m2K; U in W/m2K; dP_t and dP_s in kPa. Tube-side stream: the cold stream in every process exchanger, the only assignment that keeps both published pressure drops within the allowables of Table 3 for E1 (6.1), E4 (6.1), E2 (5.1) and E3 (5.1); taken as the same for the two exchangers where both assignments fit (E3 of 6.1, E4 of 5.1). Coolers (C) and heaters (H1, H2): shells only (cooling-water and steam properties are not published).
